title: 10. Exercises: Mixing Concurrency Models
objectives: Solve the Mixing Concurrency Models exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
### Exercise 1: Async Web Scraper with CPU Processing

Create scraper that:

1. Fetches pages async
2. Processes content in process pool
3. Saves results async

### Exercise 2: Real-time Data Pipeline

Create pipeline:

1. Async data ingestion
2. CPU-intensive transform
3. Async database storage

### Exercise 3: File Processing Service

Create service:

1. Async file upload
2. Process in process pool
3. Async notification

### Exercise 4: Hybrid Cache

Create cache that:

1. Async Redis operations
2. CPU-intensive serialization
3. Thread-safe access

### Exercise 5: Load Balancer

Create load balancer:

1. Async request handling
2. Process pool workers
3. Health checking

### Exercise 6: Event Processor

Create processor:

1. Async event ingestion
2. CPU-intensive analysis
3. Async event publishing

### Exercise 7: Image Service

Create image service:

1. Async upload
2. Process pool resize/filter
3. Async storage

### Exercise 8: Search Engine

Create search:

1. Async indexing
2. CPU-intensive ranking
3. Async response

### Exercise 9: ML Inference API

Create API:

1. Async request handling
2. Process pool inference
3. Async response

### Exercise 10: Monitoring System

Create monitor:

1. Async metric collection
2. CPU-intensive aggregation
3. Async alerting
